name: Culture Amp
summary: Engagement surveys and performance management with AI.
description: Culture Amp measures employee engagement through surveys and manages performance reviews and development. Its AI summarizes comments and suggests actions for managers.

description_fr: Culture Amp mesure l'engagement des employés par enquêtes, gère les entretiens de performance et le développement. Son IA résume les commentaires et suggère des actions aux managers.
